title: ShengPay Merchant Management
isvNotConnectedTip: The channel for ShengPay service provider (ISV) mode is not yet connected. Related configurations are reserved only and cannot be used for actual transactions.
cardMchKeyDesc: Configure ShengPay merchant No and RSA signing key
cardIsvKeyDesc: Configure the ShengPay service provider merchant No and RSA signing key (product-level global)
subMchIdTooltip: The service provider initiates transactions on behalf of sub merchants; enter the sub merchant No at ShengPay (required in service provider mode)
subMchIdPlaceholder: Please enter the sub merchant No
sdpAppIdTooltip: App ID assigned by ShengPay (sdpAppId); optional for aggregated payment in phase one
sdpAppIdPlaceholder: Please enter the app ID assigned by ShengPay (sdpAppId, optional)
privateKeyTooltip: Merchant RSA private key (PEM format, PKCS#1/PKCS#8 accepted) for request signing; masked when already configured, clear and re-paste to update
privateKeyPlaceholder: Paste the merchant RSA private key (PEM format, with -----BEGIN/END markers)
publicKeyTooltip: ShengPay RSA public key (PEM format) for response/callback signature verification; masked when already configured, clear and re-paste to update
publicKeyPlaceholder: Paste the ShengPay RSA public key (PEM format, with -----BEGIN/END markers)
isvMchNoTooltip: Service provider (agent) merchant No at ShengPay, globally unique at product level
isvMchNoPlaceholder: Please enter the service provider merchant No
isvPrivateKeyTooltip: Service provider RSA private key (PEM format, PKCS#1/PKCS#8 accepted) for request signing; masked when already configured, clear and re-paste to update
isvPrivateKeyPlaceholder: Paste the service provider RSA private key (PEM format, with -----BEGIN/END markers)
cardCapabilityBindingDesc: Bind WeChat app to the channel merchant (JSAPI/Mini Program payment)
